text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-The Tenno Sho (Spring)... That race is 
way, way too out of my league...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I want to show that I can run 
long-distance races properly too. H-Here I 
gooo!”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Doto! To think we'd run into each 
other here before the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san. Please go easy on me 
today~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Today is less about competing 
and more about the parade! ...In spirit, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You know how it is at theme parks, right? 
Princes, princesses, mascots... A dazzling 
parade with the whole cast together.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's just like that. In other words, today 
is our debut ceremony! For you and me, as 
we run together this whole year!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Doto? As the lead actor, can 
you properly guide this Overlord?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Pacing the lead...? Y-Yes, I can do it...! 
Though 3,200 meters is going to be really 
tough...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I won't mess up this time. I won't give 
up—not until the very end...!

First, the prep race for the Takarazuka 
Kinen. Let us begin our trial march upon 
the slopes of Yodo.
